title: Fate Rewinder Anime New Trailer, Key Visual and April 2027 Release Date Revealed
content: Fate Rewinder anime film by studio Bones Film revealed a new teaser trailer and key visual, along with an April 2027 release date. Rie Matsumoto, whose previous direction credits include Kyosogiga (2013) and Blood Blockade Battlefront ( Kekkai Sensen , 2015), directs the new anime.
author: Anime Corner

title: Solo Leveling Series Gets Solo Leveling: Beyond the System Anime Film
content: Crunchyroll announced during its panel at Anime Expo on Friday that the Solo Leveling series is getting an anime film titled Solo Leveling : Beyond the System . The film, which continues the story after the second season, is currently in production.
author: ANN

title: Solo Leveling Announces Anime Return With New Movie
content: Jinwoo Sung has become a big name in the anime world, and it makes sense why. Solo Leveling’s debut in 2024 was, reportedly, so popular that it crashed Crunchyroll’s server on the first day of its premiere.
author: ComicBook

title: Solo Leveling: Beyond the System New Anime Film Announced
content: Solo Leveling is officially getting a new anime film, titled Solo Leveling: Beyond the System . The announcement comes almost a year and a half since the Season 2 finale , with the news arriving during Anime Expo 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 7: Steel Ball Run Anime's '2nd Stage' Begins on September 25
content: Warner Bros. Japan announced during its Anime Expo panel on Friday for the STEEL BALL RUN JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure anime that the "second stage" will begin on September 25. New episodes will stream every week on Fridays. There will be 11 episodes in total for the second and third stages.
author: ANN

title: The Elusive Samurai Season 2's New Video Unveils Opening Song, Cast, Staff, July 13 Debut
content: The staff for the second television anime season based on Yūsei Matsui 's The Elusive Samurai ( Nigejōzu no Wakagimi ) manga unveiled on Saturday the season's main promotional video, opening theme song, cast, staff, and July 17 premiere.
author: ANN

title: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run’s Return Reveals Release Date And More
content: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run is regarded as one of the best storylines of the franchise, introducing the anime world to the alternate reality wherein Johnny Joestar is racing across North America on horseback.
